addons.name: FFmpeg
addons.title: ProRes-compatible export (via FFmpeg)
addons.description: Encodes video with alpha and professional codecs (ProRes-compatible 422 HQ and 4444, QuickTime Animation, PNG in MOV, WebM with alpha, H.264, H.265). RSMPS does not include FFmpeg; you can download it here or point RSMPS at an FFmpeg you already have.

bringYourOwn.win32: Install FFmpeg yourself (for example: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg) and press Locate, or put ffmpeg.exe on your PATH.
bringYourOwn.darwin: Install FFmpeg yourself (for example: brew install ffmpeg) and press Locate, or put ffmpeg on your PATH.
bringYourOwn.linux: Install FFmpeg with your package manager (for example: sudo apt install ffmpeg) and press Locate, or put ffmpeg on your PATH.
